You can make three or four rows of ribbon for a smaller tee, or a longer, more streamlined “drape” (a pinnwell row makes the fabric wider, while a ribbon row keeps it from folding; that's why you want fewer ribbon rows). When I first made this pattern, I worked up a few swatches for fun, which resulted in some really cute pinwheel and ribbon “curtains,” so that's how it turned out.
